summary_of_change:
In operational reality, MercadoLibre is compounding at an industry-leading rate while widening its competitive moat across Latin America. Over the latest four quarters, net revenue accelerated to a record $10,169.0M in Q2 2026 (+49.8% YoY reported, +43.0% FX-neutral), driving the annualized revenue run-rate to $40,676.0M. Gross merchandise volume (GMV) reached $21.9B for the quarter (+44% YoY in USD), supported by 89.0M unique active buyers and a 56% surge in items sold in Brazil. The fintech ecosystem expanded in tandem, with Mercado Pago monthly active users reaching 88.0M, total payment volume (TPV) surpassing $101.0B in a single quarter (+56% YoY), and the credit portfolio scaling to $16.4B.

While headline GAAP operating margins contracted to 6.7% in Q2 2026, the underlying drivers are disciplined, value-accretive investments rather than structural decay. Gross margin settled at 40.9%, reflecting intentional shipping subsidies to widen delivery density leads and upfront CECL credit provisioning on rapidly expanding credit card cohorts. Crucially, Net Interest Margin After Losses (NIMAL) expanded sequentially to 21.0%, with 15–90 day delinquencies well-managed at 7.0% consolidated and 4.6% for credit cards. High-margin Mercado Ads grew over 65% FX-neutral to reach 2.2% of GMV, providing an expanding structural profit cushion.

Cash generation remains exceptionally strong, with operating cash flow surging to $3,737.0M in Q2 2026. CapEx of $441.0M remains heavily oriented toward growth fulfillment hubs. Capital allocation is strictly disciplined: share dilution is negligible with diluted share count flat at 50.7M, zero capital wasted on un-economic buybacks, and debt issuance strategically utilized to fund high-yielding credit assets without equity dilution.
